headline: 生化危机领跑电影 黑鸽登顶剧集
headlineEn: Resident Evil Leads Films, Black Doves Tops TV
summary: 今日无新片上映，本周仅两部新片入市；电影端《生化危机：爆发夜》与《野兽之心》领跑，剧集端《黑鸽》登顶日榜，《再婚皇后》稳居周榜。
summaryEn: No new films opened today, with only two new movies this week; Resident Evil: Outbreak Night and Heart of the Beast lead film heat, while Black Doves tops the daily TV chart and The Remarried Empress holds the weekly TV lead.

industryHighlights.text: 今日无新片上映，本周仅两部新片入市。
industryHighlights.en: No new films opened today; only two new movies arrived this week.

industryHighlights.text: 电影热度由《生化危机：爆发夜》与《野兽之心》领跑。
industryHighlights.en: Resident Evil: Outbreak Night and Heart of the Beast lead movie heat.

industryHighlights.text: 剧集周榜由《再婚皇后》《夜曲》居前，MobLand持续在榜。
industryHighlights.en: The Remarried Empress and Nocturne top the TV weekly chart, with MobLand still on the list.

industryHighlights.text: 近期暂无重点待映项目。
industryHighlights.en: There are no notable upcoming releases at present.
